name: week
title: Security log review week
subtitle: Imported records only; collection health requires a separate check

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select kind,item,owner,issue,detail from attention order by kind,item,issue

sections.title: Source coverage
sections.sql: select name,owner,event_count,latest_event,coverage_status from coverage order by name

sections.title: Selected administrative events
sections.sql: select source,occurred_at,actor,event_code,message from event_register where event_code in ('4728','4732','4756','4672') or lower(action) like '%privileg%' or lower(action) like '%group membership%' order by occurred_at

name: compliance
title: Stored-record checks
subtitle: Policy and evidence findings, not a compliance certificate

sections.title: Review findings
sections.sql: select kind,item,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by kind,item,rule
